correctness.rationale: Every determinant is exactly equivalent to 2+2cosh(eta+kd)-kC. The inverse-hyperbolic boundary W has explicit negative second derivative, making critical right endpoints strictly decreasing, while adjacent violation intervals overlap and extend to negative-infinity odds. An independent strictly convex sign function yields a single finite block, and the endpoint/equality statements follow exactly. Standalone checked 2240 rational polynomial identities and 4 exact boundary cases; finite diagnostics do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The natural minimal heterogeneous Poisson mixing law receives a necessary-and-sufficient shape classification, including a sharp one-sided parameter boundary and localization of every failure. It reveals discontinuity of all-index shape under vanishing mixing contamination, not captured by fixed-range checks, dispersion, or Poisson-like tail asymptotics. Extensions to 3+ rates remain open.
